components.name: Icon
components.summary: Line icons on a 24px grid with a 1.8px round stroke, coloured by currentColor.

components.name: Button
components.summary: Buttons for actions: primary (accent fill) for the one main action on a screen, secondary (card with outline) for the rest, ghost for back/toolbar actions.

components.name: SearchField
components.summary: The search input at the top of Home and the browse screens.

components.name: SectionHeader
components.summary: A section title with an optional trailing link, used above every carousel and list.

components.name: BackButton
components.summary: The round back control at the top-left of every screen below the top level (show detail, season episodes, settings).

components.name: PosterArt
components.summary: The 2:3 artwork for a show or movie, used at every size so posters look identical across the app.

components.name: PosterCard
components.summary: A 2:3 poster with watched, favourite and watchlist toggles, then a meta line and title; the main unit of every carousel.

components.name: MediaRow
components.summary: A horizontal card for one show or movie: small poster, title, a meta line and optional watched progress, used for Continue Watching and list views.

components.name: AiringRow
components.summary: One upcoming episode of a tracked show: a date tile, the show and episode, and when it airs; used in Home's Airing Soon list.

components.name: CastCard
components.summary: One actor: a 4:5 headshot, their name and the character they play; shown in a sideways-scrolling Cast row on show and movie pages.

components.name: Chip
components.summary: A pill-shaped filter toggle, used in rows to narrow a list (All / Shows / Movies on search results).

components.name: Switch
components.summary: An on/off toggle for settings that take effect immediately (notifications, auto-backup, hide watched).

components.name: ProgressBar
components.summary: A 6px rounded bar for watched progress (episodes in a show, a season).

components.name: SeasonRow
components.summary: A tappable row for one season with its watched count; opens that season's episodes.

components.name: EpisodeCard
components.summary: An episode with its still, number, title, air date, runtime, a two-line synopsis and a watched toggle.

components.name: StatTile
components.summary: One number with a caption, laid out two per row on the Stats screen.

components.name: BottomNav
components.summary: The six-tab bar at the bottom of every screen: Home, Watchlist, Lists, Movies, Shows, Profile.
